elements.rulesbackgammon:
Here are the rules... 
Welcome to Backgammon remastered with gemini 

For your information: Black plays from 24 to 1 (counter-clockwise) 
White plays from 1 to 24 (clockwise) 
Checks that are individually on a spike 
can be captured and then land on the bar. 
Checks from the bar must first be moved back onto the board. 
To do this, simply click on a possible space (in the opponent's home board) according to the dice roll. 
If all checkers of one color are in the home board (last quarter), 
the checker can be moved from the board (to the finish) by double-clicking.
If no move is possible, please press the 'pass move' button. 
 Have fun and enjoy playing!!
